description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2129/95 of 28.06.2019 that published on Galle Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter that rectifies a previous gazette notification (No. 2129/95) regarding the Urban Development Authority Law. It involves amendments to legal wording, corrections to statutory notices, and clarification of legal provisions related to urban development planning. The content focuses on regulatory corrections and legal interpretations rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
